title: Mag-9 Gloss White

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: Tailored for classic roadsters and urban cruising, the Bell Mag-9 Gloss White is crafted for classic motorcycle enthusiasts seeking unrestricted peripheral sightlines. Featuring a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan architecture at a featherweight 1275g, it combines progressive kinetic energy dissipation across DOT certifications with an acoustically tuned ~96 dB aero profile. The interior features a plush, moisture-wicking crown liner shaped for Intermediate Oval head shapes, secured by track-proven Double D-Ring retention for effortless warm-weather riding.

product_details.description: Versatile sena-ready open face with internal sun shield.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Standard Bell fit; slightly narrow in the cheek area for some users; requires precise sizing as it does not stretch significantly.

technical_analysis: Features 3K Carbon Fiber shell featuring Flex Impact Liner with progressive three-layer density rotational energy management paired with Panovision Class-1 optics visor with extended lateral field of view. The interior utilizes Virus CoolJade anti-bacterial lining paired with Magnefusion magnetic removable cheek pads with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Bell Mag-9 Gloss White: combining United States 🇺🇸 craftsmanship with Panovision Class-1 optics visor with extended lateral field of view and Virus CoolJade anti-bacterial lining paired with Magnefusion magnetic removable cheek pads. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.

introduction: Positioned in Bell's Open Face lineup, the Mag-9 Gloss White brings American engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT track safety.
story:
The Bell Mag-9 Gloss White represents Bell's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~96 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan Open Face helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Bell Mag-9 Gloss White delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
